Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: seamless repair of ONE existing approved loading-image BACKGROUND MASTER, not a new scene.
Input image is the EDIT TARGET. Output opaque RGB PNG at exactly the same 1254 x 1254 square canvas and framing.

Correct only the faint pale rectangular balloon-removal patch near the center of the sky: the old patch roughly spans x541-724, y397-716, especially the vertical edges around x541 and x724 and its lower edge. The visible fault is an overly even, slightly brighter sky region; remove the local tonal discontinuity and any straight vertical or horizontal border. Use the naturally continuing surrounding blue-gray to warm sand sky gradient, fine irregular atmospheric texture and existing soft cloud bands. Clouds crossing the region must connect naturally across it. No uniform light blob, repeating cloud clone, obvious rectangle, differently grained fill, visible feather ring or straight seam, even under twice-normal contrast. Make a broad organic seamless transition over several dozen pixels around the patch, not a narrow rectangular fill. The correction is confined to this local sky region and its soft surrounding blend, approximately x450-820,y330-760; do not change anything else.

LOCK AND PRESERVE: exact existing camera, original city skyline and every tower/building below roughly y775, horizon, haze elsewhere, all unrelated clouds, overall exposure and subdued photographic colors. Keep the tiny stone weight with its recessed iron eye at approximately x638,y992 entirely unchanged, in exactly the same position and scale. Keep the ground bank, the entire lower25percent and dark warm-brown footer #1d1610 unchanged. Do not add or remove city structures or relight the scene. No whole-scene regeneration, enhancement, recoloring, new clouds outside the small correction area or composition change.

This input background has NO balloon and NO basket; keep it that way. Do not add a balloon envelope, basket, rope, rigging, person, aircraft, text, logo, watermark, sign or border. The separate approved balloon envelope/basket PNGs will remain untouched. Only smooth the sky patch into continuous physically believable real-camera sky, retaining original fine grain and soft haze.
One authorised background repair edit only, no variants.

Recreate its round upper pear-shaped envelope, tapering neck, alternating vertical muted brick-red(#b03a2b) and cream(#faf4d6)fabric gores, sparse thin dark-brown(#46331f)crossing netting and one thin horizontal ring. Keep the long delicate suspension to a separate carrier hoop and a VERY SMALL empty gold-brown wicker basket(#d9a13b/#8a6114). A thin anchor rope trails into haze above the dark footer. No people, burner flames, advertising, text or logos.

Balloon-and-rigging must be quite small in the square: its TOP begins forty percent DOWN from the upper edge, and the BASKET ends near sixty-three percent. Do not put it near the top or enlarge it. It must stay whole inside both a full-height tall phone crop and a bottom-anchored4:3landscape crop. Top8% is quiet empty sky. Plenty of soft real clouded sky above balloon, not paper.
Background: distant anonymous contemporary European city, hazy modest domes/spires and a few modern plain towers, no identifiable landmark, signage or people. Its subdued silhouette lies around70%–74%height and fades out before75%. Natural calm pale dusty-blue/cream/warm sand atmospheric colour; restrained exposure, no HDR, dramatic cinema glow or oversaturated sunset.
